# Database Schema (Drizzle ORM)

## Schema Generation Strategy

**Auth tables** are auto-generated by BetterAuth CLI:

```bash
npx @better-auth/cli@latest generate
npx drizzle-kit generate
npx drizzle-kit migrate
```

**App tables** (orders, songs, order_messages) are written manually.

## Drizzle Adapter Config

```typescript
drizzleAdapter(db, {
  provider: "pg",
  usePlural: true,
})
```

---

## App Tables

### 1. Orders (`orders`)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key |
| userId | UUID | FK → users.id |
| lemonSqueezyOrderId | String | Unique |
| tier | Enum | `standard` \| `premium` |
| status | Enum | See status flow below |
| recipientName | String | |
| recipientRelationship | String | e.g., "Mom", "Best Friend" |
| occasion | String | e.g., "Birthday", "Anniversary" |
| storyPrompt | Text | User's story/memories |
| genre | String | e.g., "Pop", "Acoustic" |
| vibe | String | e.g., "Upbeat", "Emotional" |
| amountPaid | Integer | In cents |
| createdAt | Timestamp | |
| updatedAt | Timestamp | |

**Status Flow:**

```
pending_payment → paid → in_progress → review → completed
                                    ↘ revision_requested
                                           ↓
                                       in_progress
```

### 2. Songs (`songs`)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key |
| orderId | UUID | FK → orders.id |
| title | String | Generated song title |
| audioUrl | String | R2 URL |
| coverArtUrl | String? | R2 URL |
| lyrics | Text | |
| version | Integer | 1, 2, 3... |
| isSelected | Boolean | Finalized version |
| createdAt | Timestamp | |

### 3. Messages (`order_messages`)

| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key |
| orderId | UUID | FK → orders.id |
| senderId | UUID | FK → users.id |
| content | Text | |
| isRead | Boolean | Default: false |
| createdAt | Timestamp | |

---

## Relations

- User → has many → Orders
- Order → has many → Songs (versions)
- Order → has many → Messages
